intro.text: A Luthadel noble and cousin of House Elariel.

items.text: Danced with Valette Renoux several times at the balls. At the last ball at Keep Venture, when she approached him, he and his companions, including Yestal and Triss, snubbed her and walked off. Idren looked apologetic, but the group gathered again once she had gone; Valette saw that the nobles were drawing together with their close allies to hold on to power.
